summary: Iteration 236 - Batch 24 (AI Anomaly Detection) tested. Backend: 18/18 passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified and interactive features working including LLM explain.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/anomaly/scan/{property_id}?days=60 returns anomalies list with by_metric and by_severity totals. Validates days 14..365.

GET /api/anomaly/timeseries/{property_id}?metric=revenue&days=90 returns points array with is_anomaly flag, mean, std, anomaly_count. Validates metric in (revenue|bookings|occupancy|adr|cancellations).
POST /api/anomaly/explain returns {source, hypothesis, actions}. When EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present source='llm' and hypothesis is Turkish GPT-5.2 output.
All endpoints require auth + admin/manager role (401 without token, 403 for receptionist).
Frontend AnomalyPanel has 2 tabs: 'Anomali Akışı' (Feed) and 'Zaman Serisi' (Series).
Feed tab: KPI tiles (total=19, severe=9, moderate=10, days), days/metric filters, anomaly rows with spike/drop icons, 'Açıkla' button calls explain API and renders hypothesis + actions.
Series tab: metric + days selectors, KPI tiles (mean, std, anomaly_count), SVG chart with ±2σ band, anomaly dots highlighted red/amber.
LLM explain returns real Turkish GPT-5.2 output with actionable insights.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing property 'default' with synthetic booking data that produces realistic anomalies
